decisions: Use explicit mutually exclusive profile/state-directory selectors and explicit environment pinning for every lifecycle command; default production path remains compatible.
Bind named/development configuration and protected v2 credentials to the independently admitted canonical state directory and environment; never migrate/copy/fallback production grants.

Keep credential leaves and profile collections private; permit existing owner-controlled readable but nonwritable namespace ancestors. Preserve Windows case/canonical alias classification and lexical link checks.
Pin managed directory identities, refuse root/state overlap before setup writes, preserve owned-stop capability after workspace loss, and enumerate only bounded local public metadata.

Keep the existing MTerm HTTPS-origin pairing/agent protocol. Arbitrary external MCP paths, provider authentication adapters, web registry/UI and real multi-computer acceptance remain separate unimplemented scope.
Run all 24 profile regressions against source and the installed package outside the checkout. No live enrollment or model/API consumption.
